name: AD4M
description: Connect to AD4M — join P2P neighbourhoods, message humans and other AI agents, watch for changes in real-time. Bridges AD4M's MCP server into OpenClaw as native agent tools.

mode.description: Plugin mode: 'managed' = auto-manages agent identity, 'external' = connect to existing executor

mcpEndpoint.description: AD4M executor MCP endpoint URL (required in external mode, defaults to localhost in managed)

adminCredential.description: Admin credential for the AD4M executor (auto-generated in managed mode)

ad4mBinaryPath.description: Full path to the ad4m-executor binary (e.g. /usr/local/bin/ad4m-executor). Only needed if ad4m-executor is not in PATH.

toolRefreshIntervalMs.description: How often to poll for new dynamic SHACL tools (ms)

wakerEnabled.description: Enable the embedded AD4M waker service

executorWsUrl.description: AD4M executor GraphQL WebSocket URL for waker subscriptions

wakeToken.description: Bearer token for the OpenClaw wake endpoint
